ex.en: Have you finished writing your thesis?
Are you preparing for your thesis defense?
The defense of the master thesis is just happening next month.
ex.zh: 下個月就要碩士論文口試了。

ex.en: I won't try to refute your theses.
ex.zh: 我不會試圖反駁你的論點。

ex.en: The main thesis of the book is simple.
ex.zh: 這本書的主要論點很簡單。

ex.en: This theory is too difficult for me to comprehend.
ex.zh: 這個理論對我來說太難懂了。

ex.en: I can't find a single flaw in his theory.
ex.zh: 我在他的理論中找不到任何問題。

ex.en: John Dalton was the creator of the atomic theory.
ex.zh: 約翰．道耳頓是原子論的創立者。

ex.en: I don't want to hear your theories.
My friend believes conspiracy theories; should I try to prove him wrong?
ex.zh: 我朋友相信陰謀論，我該試著證明他是錯的嗎？

ex.en: In theory, the plan should work.
ex.zh: 理論上，這個計畫應該行得通。

ex.en: It sounds good in theory, but it's hard in practice.
ex.zh: 理論上聽起來不錯，實際上卻很難。

ex.en: There will be thunderstorms in the afternoon.
We stayed inside during the thunderstorm.
ex.zh: 雷雨期間我們都待在室內。

ex.en: The new system doubled our throughput.
ex.zh: 新系統讓我們的處理量增加了一倍。

ex.en: Network throughput drops when many users are online.
ex.zh: 很多使用者同時上線時，網路傳輸量會下降。

ex.en: The policeman took the thief by the arm.
Watch out for thieves around here.
The thief got away with the money.
